facts.business: SOBHA Limited is a backward-integrated real estate developer operating across residential and commercial property development, EPC contracting, and manufacturing of construction materials such as concrete products, glazing, metal works, and interiors.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company is aiming in FY '27 net cash -- net operating cash flow close to INR 2,000 crores.
The Company has initiated the integration of Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) into its projects and targets to conduct LCAs for 50% of raw materials used in construction by FY 2030.
guidance_or_targets.metric: Life Cycle Assessment coverage of raw materials

key_risks: Interest rate risk on gratuity plan
Asset liability matching risk (ALM risk) on gratuity plan
Concentration risk on gratuity plan assets
